sections.title: Pieces of Heart
sections.note: Every four make a heart. Pieces are kept through the Song of Time, but a minigame or trade chain has to be finished within one cycle.

items.name: Tree in North Clock Town
items.howTo: Climb the pillars beside the slide and jump into the branches of the tree, or roll up the slide as a Goron.

items.name: Clock Tower ledge
items.howTo: Trade the Moon's Tear (look through the Astral Observatory's telescope at the Clock Tower and pick it up where it lands in Termina Field) to the Business Scrub by the Clock Tower for the Land Title Deed, then use his Deku flower to fly up to the piece on the Clock Tower's entrance platform.

items.name: Deku Scrub Playground
items.howTo: Fly over the fence by the Great Fairy's Fountain as a Deku and win the Deku Scrub Playground on Day 1, Day 2 and the Final Day (6 a.m.–11 p.m.) of the same cycle. The piece comes after the third win.

items.name: Swordsman's School expert course
items.howTo: Pay for the expert course and split every log with a jump attack for a perfect 30 points. Not open on the Night of the Final Day.

items.name: Postman's counting game
items.howTo: On Day 1 from 3 p.m. or Day 2 from 5 p.m. (until midnight), play the Postman's game in the Post Office: stop the timer at exactly 10.00 seconds. Wear the Bunny Hood and the timer stays on screen.

items.name: Hand in the inn toilet
items.area: Stock Pot Inn, East Clock Town
items.howTo: Between midnight and 6 a.m. on any night, the hand in the Stock Pot Inn's toilet (the ??? of the Bombers' Notebook) asks for paper. Give it a Title Deed or a letter (the Letter to Kafei or the Special Delivery to Mama).
items.notes: You need the Room Key to get into the inn at night, or come in before it locks at 8 p.m.

items.name: Keaton's quiz
items.area: North Clock Town (also Milk Road and Mountain Village)
items.howTo: Wear the Keaton Mask and cut the ring of dancing bushes in North Clock Town until Keaton appears. Answer all five of his questions correctly.

items.name: Postbox
items.howTo: Wear the Postman's Hat and check any postbox in Clock Town.

items.name: Rosa Sisters' dance
items.howTo: On Night 1 or Night 2 (6 p.m.–6 a.m.), wear Kamaro's Mask and dance for the Rosa Sisters as they practise in West Clock Town.

items.name: Town Shooting Gallery perfect score
items.area: Town Shooting Gallery, East Clock Town
items.howTo: Score a perfect 50 (every red Octorok) at the Town Shooting Gallery (6 a.m.–10 p.m.). A score of 40 or more first gives a Quiver upgrade; the piece comes for 50 after that.

items.name: Honey & Darling's games
items.area: Honey & Darling's Shop, East Clock Town
items.howTo: Win the game of the day on all three days of one cycle (6 a.m.–10 p.m.): Bombchu targets on Day 1, bombs into baskets on Day 2 and arrows at targets on the Final Day. The piece comes after the third win.

items.name: Treasure Chest Shop as a Goron
items.area: Treasure Chest Shop, East Clock Town
items.howTo: Play the Treasure Chest Shop's maze game as a Goron; the Goron prize is a Piece of Heart. The prize depends on your form.

items.name: Grandma's story of the Carnival
items.area: Stock Pot Inn, East Clock Town
items.howTo: On Day 1 or Day 2, wear the All-Night Mask in Anju's Grandmother's room and listen to her story of the Carnival of Time. Answer her question correctly (the eve of the carnival).

items.name: Grandma's story of the Four Giants
items.area: Stock Pot Inn, East Clock Town
items.howTo: On Day 1 or Day 2, wear the All-Night Mask and listen to her story of the Four Giants. When she asks, answer "I dunno".

items.name: Mayor Dotour
items.howTo: Between 10 a.m. and 8 p.m. on Day 1 or Day 2 (10 a.m.–6 p.m. on the Final Day), wear the Couple's Mask into the meeting room of the Mayor's Residence to end the argument, then talk to the Mayor.

items.name: Bank: 5,000 Rupees
items.area: Clock Town Bank, West Clock Town
items.howTo: Have 5,000 Rupees deposited in the bank in all. Deposits stay through the Song of Time, so this builds up over many cycles.
items.notes: The Zora Cape pot game (90 Rupees a go) and the ReDeads of Ikana Castle with the Captain's Hat or Garo's Mask are quick money.

items.name: Peahat grotto
items.area: Grotto in the long grass, south Termina Field
items.howTo: Find the hidden hole in the patch of long grass (with butterflies) in south Termina Field. Inside, beat the giant Peahat for the piece. It's asleep at night, which makes it easier.

items.name: Dodongo grotto
items.area: Grotto under a mushroom rock, north Termina Field
items.howTo: Drop into the hole under one of the mushroom-shaped rocks in the snowy north of Termina Field and beat the two Dodongos. Bombs help.

items.name: Business Scrub's hideout
items.howTo: After trading him the Moon's Tear, look through the Astral Observatory's telescope again and watch the Business Scrub fly off until he drops into a hole in Termina Field. Go into that hole; he offers the piece for 150 Rupees, then 100 if you say no.
items.notes: You have to watch him land through the telescope for him to be there.

items.name: Gossip Stone grottos
items.howTo: In each of the four Gossip Stone grottos (south, west, north and east field), play your form's song to the big stone: the Sonata of Awakening as a Deku, the Goron Lullaby as a Goron or the New Wave Bossa Nova as a Zora. When all four big stones glow the same colour, the last one gives the piece.
items.notes: Use the same form for all four. The Mask of Truth lets the stones hint at this.

items.name: Beehive grotto
items.area: Grotto under a boulder, west Termina Field
items.howTo: Blow up or Goron-punch the boulder near the stone fence in west Termina Field. Inside, shoot down the beehives; one drops a piece into the water, which you fetch as a Zora.

items.name: Doggy Racetrack
items.howTo: Win 150 Rupees or more on one race at Mamamu Yan's Doggy Racetrack (6 a.m.–8 p.m.): pick up a dog, bet 50 Rupees and come first. The Mask of Truth shows which dog thinks it'll win.
items.after: Powder Keg, to blow up the boulder on Milk Road

items.name: Tree on the Road to Southern Swamp
items.howTo: Shoot or bubble the Bad Bats around the big tree at the fork in the road, then climb the vines to the piece at the top.

items.name: Swamp Shooting Gallery
items.area: Swamp Shooting Gallery, Road to Southern Swamp
items.howTo: Score 2,180 or more at the Swamp Shooting Gallery (6 a.m.–10 p.m.). A perfect run of 2,120 or more first gives a Quiver upgrade; the piece comes for 2,180 after that.
items.notes: Zelda Wiki and Zelda Dungeon give 2,180; StrategyWiki says 2,120, which is the quiver threshold.

items.name: Swamp Tourist Center roof
items.howTo: As human Link, trade the Land Title Deed to the Business Scrub by the Swamp Tourist Center for the Swamp Title Deed, then use his Deku flower to reach the piece on the roof.

items.name: Pictograph Contest
items.howTo: Take a pictograph of the Deku King or of Tingle (at the swamp's entrance) and show it to the Tourist Center guide while the swamp is still poisoned, before Woodfall Temple is cleared.
items.notes: The contest runs only until Odolwa falls in that cycle; play the Song of Time to bring it back.

items.name: Deku Palace garden
items.howTo: As a Deku, get past the palace guards and take the left-hand garden. Sneak past the patrolling guards (or wear the Stone Mask) to the piece at the end.

items.name: Koume's boat archery
items.howTo: After saving Koume in the Woods of Mystery and clearing Woodfall Temple in the same cycle, take her boat cruise and shoot at least 20 of the targets she carries. Ten hits on Koume herself end the game.
items.notes: In Majora's Mask 3D this game gives an Empty Bottle instead, and the Piece of Heart moves to Dampé's grave on the Final Night.

items.name: Woodfall chest
items.howTo: From the platform with the Owl Statue, fly from Deku flower to Deku flower to the last platform; its chest holds the piece.

items.name: Goron Village ledge
items.howTo: As a Deku, trade the Swamp Title Deed to the Business Scrub on the upper ledge to the right of Goron Village's entrance for the Mountain Title Deed, then use his flower to reach the piece above.

items.name: Hidden ledge on the Road to Snowhead
items.howTo: Use the Lens of Truth on the road's chasm to see the hidden platforms and jump across them. Where Tatl flies off and changes colour, play the Scarecrow's Song; the scarecrow appears on a far ledge and you Hookshot to it and the piece.
items.after: Lens of Truth, Hookshot and the Scarecrow's Song
items.notes: Teach Pierre the Scarecrow your song first (Trading Post or Astral Observatory); he forgets it when you play the Song of Time.

items.name: Chest in the thawed pond
items.howTo: Once Goht is beaten and spring comes, the frozen pond by the Path to Goron Village thaws. Dive in as a Zora for the chest at the bottom.

items.name: Frog Choir
items.howTo: Wear Don Gero's Mask and talk to the four other frogs: at the Laundry Pool, on a log in the Southern Swamp (after the poison is cleared), and the ones left behind after the Gekko in Woodfall Temple and in Great Bay Temple. Then, in spring, conduct the choir at the Mountain Village pond.
items.after: Don Gero's Mask, Woodfall and Great Bay temples
items.notes: Only the gathering of the frogs needs to be in one cycle, together with spring in Mountain Village.

items.name: Marine Research Lab fish
items.area: Marine Research Lab, Great Bay Coast
items.howTo: Climb onto the tank with two big fish and drop in fish from your Bottles. After four or so, one big fish eats the other and spits out the piece.

items.name: Like Like in Zora Cape's pool
items.area: Pool under the waterfall, Zora Cape
items.howTo: Dive as a Zora into the deep pool below the waterfall at the end of the Zora Cape canyon and beat the Like Like; the piece is under it.

items.name: Pirates' Fortress cage
items.howTo: In the room with a caged piece on the right, go up the stairs on the left and smash the barrels to find a floor switch. Step on it and get down to the cage before it shuts; the Bunny Hood or a Goron roll helps.

items.name: Pinnacle Rock seahorses
items.howTo: Show the Fisherman in his hut a pictograph of a Gerudo Pirate to get the Seahorse in a Bottle. Let it out at Pinnacle Rock, follow it in and beat all eight Deep Pythons to reunite the seahorses.
items.after: Pictograph Box, Zora Mask, a free Bottle

items.name: Evan's song
items.howTo: In Mikau's room, Hookshot up to his diary and read the two parts of his song. Jam the first part with Japas in his room as a Zora, then play the whole thing as human Link behind Evan in his room. He takes the song and gives you the piece.

items.name: Zora Hall ledge
items.howTo: As a Goron, trade the Mountain Title Deed to the Business Scrub in Lulu's room for the Ocean Title Deed, then use his flower to reach the piece on the ledge above.

items.name: Beaver Bros. second race
items.howTo: Hookshot up the trees to the top of Zora Cape's waterfall. Beat both Beaver Bros. in their ring race as a Zora for a Bottle, then beat them again in the harder race for the piece.

items.name: Oceanside Spider House masks
items.howTo: Wear the Captain's Hat and talk to the Stalchildren in the house: each tells you a colour in the order to shoot the masks on the wall. Shoot the masks in that order to open the way upstairs, beat the Skulltula and open the chest.
items.notes: The order is different on every save file.

items.name: Cliff above Pirates' Cove
items.area: Great Bay Coast, by Pirates' Fortress
items.howTo: Hookshot up the pillars on the east cliff near the Pirates' Fortress to a patch of soft soil. Plant a Magic Bean and water it with the Song of Storms (or Spring Water), ride the plant up, then play the Scarecrow's Song where Tatl flies off and changes colour and Hookshot to the scarecrow. The piece is in the rock face.
items.after: Hookshot, Magic Beans and the Scarecrow's Song
items.notes: Teach Pierre the Scarecrow your song first (Trading Post or Astral Observatory); he forgets it when you play the Song of Time.

items.name: Fisherman's jumping game
items.howTo: After Gyorg, ride the boat by the sign in Great Bay Coast out to the islands, Hookshot across and play the Fisherman's jumping game. Score 20 or more for the piece. Open 7 a.m.–4 a.m.

items.name: Under the graveyard, Night 2
items.howTo: On Night 2, wear the Captain's Hat and tell the Stalchildren to open their grave. Below, find the hidden way on with the Lens of Truth, cross the invisible path, bomb the cracked wall and beat the Iron Knuckle for the chest.

items.name: Ikana Canyon ledge
items.area: Lower Ikana Canyon, near Sakon's Hideout
items.howTo: As a Zora, trade the Ocean Title Deed to the Business Scrub in lower Ikana Canyon (he gives 200 Rupees), then use his flower to fly over the river to the piece on the far ledge.

items.name: Poe Sisters
items.howTo: Pay the Poe Collector in the Spirit House 30 Rupees and beat Amy, Beth, Jo and Meg within three minutes without dropping to three hearts or fewer.
items.after: Ice Arrows, to reach upper Ikana Canyon

items.name: Ancient Castle of Ikana roof
items.howTo: On the castle roof, shoot the switch to put out the burning flowers, then fly as a Deku from flower to flower to the last pillar before the fire comes back.

items.name: Secret Shrine
items.howTo: Swim upstream in Ikana Canyon's river as a Zora to a hidden door, open it with a Light Arrow at the sun above it, and beat the mini-bosses of all four rooms (Dinolfos, Wizzrobe, Wart and Garo Master). Each room also gives Rupees.

items.name: Moon: Deku trial
items.howTo: Give the child in Odolwa's mask one mask and fly through his Deku flower course. Near the end, land on the yellow flower and use it to reach the ledge with the piece.

items.name: Moon: Goron trial
items.howTo: Give the child in Goht's mask two masks and roll as a Goron along the track. The piece is in the little shrine at the end.

items.name: Moon: Zora trial
items.howTo: Give the child in Gyorg's mask three masks and swim the water maze as a Zora: left, left, right, left leads to a Gossip Stone with the piece behind it.
items.notes: In Majora's Mask 3D the maze is different: left, right, middle.

items.name: Moon: Link trial
items.howTo: Give the child in Twinmold's mask four masks. The piece is partway through his trial, past the Dinolfos, Garo Master and Iron Knuckle rooms.

sections.title: Heart Containers
sections.note: One from each temple's boss. They stay through the Song of Time.

items.name: Odolwa
items.howTo: Beat Odolwa, Woodfall Temple's boss.

items.name: Goht
items.howTo: Beat Goht, Snowhead Temple's boss.

items.name: Gyorg
items.howTo: Beat Gyorg, Great Bay Temple's boss.

items.name: Twinmold
items.howTo: Beat Twinmold, Stone Tower Temple's boss, in the inverted temple.
